newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Canada sets 3rd round of specials at 3.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Canada sets 3rd round of specials at 3.25 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Monday conducted a third round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, dealers said.

The Bank of Canada intervened to add liquidity to the money market for a third time as the call loan or overnight lending rate continued to trade in the upper half of the central bank's 2.75-3.25 percent target range.
Dealers had attributed the unusual pressure on the call loan rate during today's session to end of quarter settlement pressures and a rise in U.S. financing costs.
The central bank had set two rounds of specials at 3.25 percent in money markets on Thursday.
Canada's three-month when-issued T-bill was trading at 3.26 percent in the wake of the intervention.
